release-notes.description: Combines the changelog sections of a fixed release group into one set of GitHub release notes.

bootstrap-npm-packages.description: Publishes release projects that do not exist on npm yet and configures npm trusted publishing for them.

generate-shape-scss.description: Generates shape SCSS overrides from a Figma shape tokens JSON file.

generate-palettes-scss.description: Generates Material core and extension palette SCSS maps from a Figma palette tokens JSON file.
